findings.violation: The custom button control uses role="button" but lacks aria-pressed or aria-expanded, so users cannot determine its current state when it is interactive.
findings.fix: Add state management: <div class="icon-delete" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Delete item" aria-pressed="false" id="s3-customcontrol">

findings.location: section s3, form field, promo code input
findings.violation: The field is marked invalid but there is no associated error message with aria-describedby pointing to the error span, breaking the connection between the invalid state and the reason.
findings.fix: Add aria-describedby to link the input to the error message: <input id="promo" type="text" aria-invalid="true" aria-describedby="s3-form-promo-error">

findings.evidence: The form contains multiple input fields, including a required phone field with a label.
findings.violation: The email field has no required attribute, but the context suggests all fields should be validated before submission, and there is no clear indication which fields are optional.
findings.fix: Add aria-required="false" to optional fields or clarify in the label: <label for="email" id="s3-form-email-label">Email address (optional)</label>
